The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of iterations and the loss values for several models. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” and spans from 0 to 140000 with a linear scale, and tick labels are placed at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with a linear scale, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. 

The first line, colored blue and labeled “Vanilla”, begins at approximately 3.1 when #Iteration is 0 and gradually declines to around 2.6 at #Iteration equals 140000. The second line, colored orange and labeled “StrmLLM (n=64)”, starts at about 3.0 at #Iteration 0 and decreases to approximately 2.5 at #Iteration 140000.  The third line, colored green and labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H)”, starts at roughly 2.9 at #Iteration 0 and decreases to around 2.5 at #Iteration 140000. The fourth line, colored red and labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)”, begins at approximately 2.9 at #Iteration 0 and decreases to around 2.5 at #Iteration 140000. Finally, the fifth line, colored purple and labeled “SepLLM (n=128)”, begins at roughly 3.3 at #Iteration 0 and decreases to approximately 2.7 at #Iteration 140000.
